req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject malformed player payloads with a 422 Unprocessable Entity status. This ensures data integrity and prevents invalid data from being processed. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct payload processing, a negative case to check rejection of malformed payloads, and a boundary case to test the edge of valid input.

tests.name: test_valid_player_payload
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The player schema is correctly defined.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid player payload.
expected: The response contains the expected player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

valid_payload = {
    "first_name": "John",
    "middle_name": "",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "date_of_birth": "1990-01-01",
    "squad_number": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbr_position": "FW",
    "team": "Team A",
    "league": "League 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["first_name"] == "John"
assert response.json()["squad_number"] == 10

tests.name: test_malformed_player_payload
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The player schema is correctly defined.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a malformed player payload.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating validation failure.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

malformed_payload = {
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "squad_number": "invalid_number",
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=malformed_payload)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "Unprocessable Entity" in response.text

tests.name: test_boundary_squad_number
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The player schema is correctly defined.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a player payload having squad_number at the boundary value.
expected: The response status code is 201 for valid boundary value.
The response status code is 422 for invalid boundary value.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Test with valid boundary value
valid_boundary_payload = {
    "first_name": "Jane",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "squad_number": 0,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}
response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_boundary_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201

# Test with invalid boundary value
invalid_boundary_payload = {
    "first_name": "Jane",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "squad_number": -1,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}
response = client.post("/players/", json=invalid_boundary_payload)
assert response.status_code == 422
